summary: End-to-end test of 'Live Wins / Success Stories' feature in Community Forum. Backend pytest 12/12 PASSED (success-stats shape, Success Story feed metadata, reactions add/swap/remove/invalid, my-reaction, POST /posts/create 403 guard on Success Story category, General Discussion regression, admin-only backfill + non-admin 403). Frontend verified against live preview: Live Wins banner with live-wins-total ('1 successful request completed · ₹2,000 disbursed'), 7 SuccessStoryCard components rendered (no timestamps anywhere on card text — verified), three reaction buttons (🎉 ❤️ 🔥) clickable with optimistic count update + persistence, regular PostCards still render with timestamps/likes/comments/bookmarks, and Create Post modal dropdown excludes 'Success Story' (shows only 6 user-allowed categories). Meta fields (service_type, first_name, location, amount_inr) present & rendered correctly (chips for Mobile/DTH/Bank Redeem, 'Successfully Completed' badge, ₹ amount).
critical_code_review_comments: community.py routes are well-structured. Reaction toggle logic (lines 523-578) correctly handles 3 paths: remove-if-same, swap-if-different (inc new / dec old atomically), or add-if-new. Counter arithmetic via $inc is atomic and safe under concurrent reacts.

create_success_story_post() (lines 43-147) is idempotent via ref_id dedup on metadata.ref_id + is_success_story flag; fire-and-forget with try/except ensures transaction flow is never blocked. Good separation of concerns.

success-stats endpoint handles case-sensitivity via $in on ['success','SUCCESS','Success','completed','COMPLETED'] and ['paid','Paid','PAID']. However, recent-activity counts use different timestamp fields ('created_at' for recharges vs 'processed_at' for bank transfers) which is correct but worth a comment in code.
create_post() 403 guard (line 226-227) correctly rejects 'Success Story' category from user input — verified via pytest. Well-placed AFTER category validation but BEFORE DB insert.

SuccessStoryCard.js is clean, self-contained: optimistic reaction updates with rollback on API error, lazy my-reaction fetch via useEffect, correct data-testid attributes (success-story-{id}, success-story-name-{id}, success-story-amount-{id}, react-{emoji}-{id}). No timestamp is rendered — matches PRD.

CommunityPage.js categories array includes '🎉 Wins' which maps to 'Success Story' in the GET posts call (line 89: activeCategory === '🎉 Wins' ? 'Success Story' : activeCategory). Create modal dropdown correctly filters out 'All' and '🎉 Wins' (line 638). Good bidirectional guard.

Minor suggestion: banner only considers recharge_transactions + bank_transfer_requests; if DTH recharges are stored in a separate collection in the future, the lifetime count could diverge from the actual seeded success_story posts. Currently they share recharge_transactions which is fine.
